summary: The Student Employment Application system is a web-based interface designed for students to submit employment applications. It includes various controls and panels for managing documents, viewing placement history, and handling warnings and errors. The application is processed through different workflows, including data binding, form submission, and email notifications.
purpose: The system allows students to submit employment applications, view document tabs, manage placement history, and receive notifications, facilitating the recruitment process in an academic environment.

entities.name: EmploymentApplication
entities.description: Represents the data structure for employment applications.

fields.name: _employmentApplicationID
fields.description: Holds the ID of the employment application.

fields.name: _data
fields.description: Stores data of the current employment application.

fields.name: _readOnly
fields.description: Indicates if the screen is in read-only mode.

workflows.name: Submit Application
steps: Retrieve employment application ID from query string.
Check read-only status based on withdrawal date.
Submit application and send notification email if no errors.
Display errors or warnings if any issues arise.

business_rules: Screen must be editable if not read-only and user is either a system administrator or matches the student ID.
validations: Check that email address is present before sending notification.
conditions: If the 'release history' option is checked, placement history is enabled.
system_behavior: System sends email notifications upon application submission if recruitment contact is available.
dependencies: User session management to control access and visibility of application panels.
exceptions: No recruitment contact email results in a warning message.
